lines.text: Most people read at the speed they speak. ... Your eyes can move much faster. ... Let them follow the light.
Here is the secret. ... Your brain loves pictures and stories. ... Let's link five new words into one crazy story. ... See each picture in your mind.
Instead of clothes, curd pours out of the suitcase!
The curd soaks a flying drone...
and the heavy drone falls right into your tiffin.
The cooker whistles and shoots out popcorn!
The popcorn lands on a sleeping buffalo...
and the buffalo sits right on your TV remote.
Now see the whole story once more in your mind.
Sit comfortably. ... Look softly at the glowing dot.
Beautiful. ... Your mind is calm and sharp.
